android.desc:
This privacy-friendly and ad-free RSS reader app allows effortless management of RSS feeds, access to favorite articles, and a customizable reading experience. 
Access a curated selection of 700+ sources on topics like technology, sports, business, travel, and global news from the US, UK, Australia, France, India, Japan, Brazil, and more.

You also have the freedom to add and personalize your own sources to follow content that interests you.

Podcast support: listen to audio content directly from your RSS feeds with a smooth and distraction-free player.

Key Features:

- Distraction-free reading mode 📖
- Save and search articles for quick access ⭐️🔍
- Listen to articles via Text-to-Speech 🎧
- Automatic feed updates 🔄
- Podcast support 🎙️
- Multiple themes: Light, Dark, AMOLED & Neon 🎨🌙
- Internal and external browser 🌐
- Ad-free  🚫📺
- No account required 🙅‍♂️
- No data collection 🚫📊
- Unlimited sources, topics, and articles 🚫🔒
- Local processing: All data is handled on your device 📲
- OPML Import/Export: Easily backup or share your feeds 📥📤

Feel free to suggest new sources to improve this RSS reader. Your feedback is highly valued, and any ideas or bug reports are welcome to help enhance  StreamSphere.
